_what_this_is: A repository that has published, moving off the zero version. The zero is what a manifest carries before anybody decided a number, so it was never a release whatever the release count says, and the change off it needs no entry. The release count is deliberately not zero: the zero-version guard is the only thing excusing this change, so deleting that guard alone refuses this document, which is what makes it a proof rather than a second copy of the one beside it.
title: Give the manifest the first number it will ship under (#189)
body:
Closes #189.

The manifest carried the template's zero, which is not a version anybody installed.
